title: Customer Feedback Summary
content_summary: Customer feedback about shipping, product descriptions, easy checkout, payment methods, clear prices.
source_note: Summary of accessible Notion test page, not a full-fidelity block export.
content:
This page summarizes sample customer feedback for an online retail business.
Customer 1: Wants faster shipping options.
Customer 2: Requested better product descriptions.
Customer 3: Found the checkout process easy.
Customer 4: Suggested adding more payment methods.
Customer 5: Appreciated the clear pricing.
Common themes: Shipping speed, website usability, and product information.
Next steps: Improve product pages, review shipping options, and simplify checkout.
